The next major software update for Apple Vision Pro has officially arrived. visionOS 27 is rolling out to all Vision Pro models starting today—here's a look at the new features.

Vision Pro gets a more powerful Siri AI and a host of new features with visionOS 27

visionOS 27 is now available for Apple Vision Pro, compatible with both the original M2 Vision Pro and the M5 model.

New features in visionOS 27 include:

  • Siri AI and the Siri app, delivering a voice-first, powerful computing experience
  • Brand-new built-in environment: Thórsmörk
  • Convert panoramic photos into spatial scenes and use them as your environment backdrop
  • Visual Intelligence lets you ask Siri about anything you're looking at
  • Ultra-small widgets
  • High-quality screen recording with no more blurry footage
  • New AI features in Home, Safari, Image Playground, and other apps
  • Support for curved windows
  • Expand notification content with your eyes
  • Redesigned Control Center
  • Accessibility features: wheelchair controls and vehicle motion cues

Without a doubt, Siri AI will be the highlight most users care about. I've always believed spatial computing would benefit enormously from a more capable Siri, and visionOS 27 delivers exactly that.

One big advantage of Siri AI on visionOS is that it launches simultaneously in the European Union. So EU users who can't yet experience the new Siri on iPhone, iPad, or Apple Watch can be among the first to try it on Vision Pro.

Which new feature in visionOS 27 is your favorite? Let us know in the comments.
